src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: For which field Shri Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy got Padma Vibhushan Award?
x: Dr D. Nageshwar Reddy, gastroenterologist and Chairman of AIG Hospitals, Hyderabad, received the Padma Vibhushan 2025 in Medicine. He is a doctor, not a public figure or sportsperson.

src: APPSC Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer (Sainik Welfare Service)
s: Who received the 'International Culture Award' in 2024?
x: Prof. Meena Charanda, Principal of Kalindi College (University of Delhi), received the International Culture Award 2024 at the India International Centre, New Delhi (30 March 2024), for education and social service. Licia Verde is a cosmologist (Gruber Prize), not this award.

src: APPSC Group-II Prelims 2024 (25-02-2024)
s:
Consider the following statements about the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2023:

I. Daniel Barenboim was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize for 2023 for his efforts to solve economic crisis and his contribution in the development of Sri Lanka.

II. Ali Abu Awwad was announced as winner of the Indira Gandhi Prize 2023 for his efforts towards a non-violent resolution of the Israel-Palestine conflict.

III. The International Jury of the Indira Gandhi Prize for Peace, Disarmament and Development for 2023 was chaired by former Chief Justice of India, R.M. Lodha.
Which among the above given statements are incorrect?
x: The 2023 Indira Gandhi Prize went jointly to pianist Daniel Barenboim and Palestinian activist Ali Abu Awwad for Israel-Palestine reconciliation, so statement II is correct. Statement I (economic crisis in Sri Lanka) is wrong, and the jury was chaired by ex-CJI T.S. Thakur, not R.M. Lodha, so III is wrong too: I and III are incorrect.

src: APPSC Assistant Environmental Engineer and Analyst Grade-II
s: Who was awarded the Nobel Prize in 2023 in the field of literature?
x: The 2023 Nobel Prize in Literature went to Norwegian writer Jon Fosse. Narges Mohammadi won Peace 2023; Katalin Karikó and Drew Weissman won Medicine 2023.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026

src: CDS 2015
s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

I. Professor Komal Bawa was conferred with the MIDORI Prize (2014) for biodiversity for his research on climate change in the himalayas.

II. MIDORI Prize is an annual international prize given to an individual for outstanding contribution to the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity at global regional or local level.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below.
x:
Official key / most books: both I and II. Strictly: the MIDORI Prize is biennial and goes to three individuals, so statement II is loose (millenniumpost.in, 2014).
Kamal Bawa (founder of ATREE, Bengaluru) won the 2014 MIDORI Prize for Biodiversity, his work including climate change in the Himalayas, and the prize honours individuals for conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity at global, regional or local level, so the key is 'both'. Strictly the prize is biennial, not annual.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s:
Which of the following statements is/are correct?

1. Padma Shri was awarded to OP Bhardwaj and Devendra Jhajharia in the sports category.

2. Padma Bhushan was awarded to Satyapal Singh for his contributions to Indian hockey.
x: Both statements are wrong. Devendra Jhajharia's latest Padma is the Padma Bhushan (2022), not the Padma Shri, and Dr Satyapal Singh is a para-athletics coach who got the Padma Shri (2025), not a Padma Bhushan for hockey (the 2025 hockey Padma Bhushan went to P.R. Sreejesh).

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Screening Test General Studies &
s:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the Padma Awards as of January 2025?

1. Any Indian National can receive the Padma Awards.

2. Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) & Overseas Citizens of India (OCIs) are eligible for Padma Awards.

3. Foreign nationals are barred from receiving Padma Awards.
x:
Official key / most books: 1 and 2. Strictly: statement 1 is loose, since serving government employees (other than doctors and scientists) are not eligible (general knowledge, not checked).
Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the Padma awards are open to all persons without distinction of race, occupation, position or sex (government servants other than doctors and scientists excepted), and NRIs/OCIs are eligible. Statement 3 is wrong: foreigners can get Padma awards (6 in 2026), outside the yearly limit of 120.

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s:
Who among the following eminent personalities are recipients of 58th Jnanpith Award?

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s: Which one of the following is not a recipient of Jnanpith Award?
x: Amartya Sen, the Nobel economist, has never received the Jnanpith, which is for Indian literature. Viswanatha Satyanarayana (1970) and C. Narayana Reddy (1988) are Telugu winners and Indira Goswami an Assamese winner.

src: Uttarakhand PCS (Pre) 2024
s: Besides Urdu poet Gulzar, who is the other recipient of the 58th Jnanpith Award ?
x: The 58th Jnanpith (2023) was shared by Gulzar and Jagadguru Rambhadracharya. Damodar Mauzo won the 57th (2022); Krishna Sobti the 53rd.

src: State PSC
s: Who has been given the Jnanpith Award for the year 2015 ?
x: The 51st Jnanpith (2015) went to Gujarati writer Raghuveer Chaudhari. Pannalal Patel and Umashankar Joshi were earlier Gujarati winners.

src: U.P. P.C.S (Pre) 2025
s:

s:
